remarks: Immaculate, sunny & Spacious Townhome in Desirable Westwood features bright, beautiful hardwood floors, designer kitchen with Stainless Appliances and fabulous, open living space lined with windows. This sought after townhome has its own private entry, on-site parking, washer/dryer upstairs and 2 sparkling full baths. Economical gas heating, central air and - NO ADDED FEES - make Westwood an ideal choice for easy living! Located in a beautifully maintained community featuring 24-hour security, Westwood is pet-friendly with the following guidelines, 1 dog 35 Lbs, 2 cats, or 1 dog & 1 cat. Westwood is a No Smoking community. Interested applicants must submit the Westwood Application uploaded in supplements with credit check through rentspree or applyconnect only.
